-- AAC Phase 1F
CREATE TEMP TABLE valid_response AS
SELECT
  rl.review_link_id, rl.article_id, rl.doctor_id, a.campaign_id,
  CASE
    WHEN @action = 'approve' THEN 'APPROVED'
    WHEN @action = 'request_changes' AND LENGTH(TRIM(@response)) > 0 THEN 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS decision
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links` rl
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a ON a.article_id = rl.article_id
WHERE rl.secure_token_hash = TO_HEX(SHA256(@token))
  AND rl.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  AND rl.status IN ('READY', 'OPENED')
  AND a.status = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW_PENDING'
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rl.created_at DESC) = 1;

DELETE FROM valid_response WHERE decision IS NULL;

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links`
SET status = 'RESPONDED', responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE review_link_id IN (SELECT review_link_id FROM valid_response);

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals`
SET
  status = (SELECT decision FROM valid_response LIMIT 1),
  responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  response = NULLIF(TRIM(@response), '')
WHERE article_id IN (SELECT article_id FROM valid_response)
  AND approval_type = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW'
  AND status = 'PENDING';

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles`
SET
  status = IF((SELECT decision FROM valid_response LIMIT 1) = 'APPROVED', 'DOCTOR_APPROVED', 'DOCTOR_CHANGES_REQUESTED'),
  doctor_approved_at = IF((SELECT decision FROM valid_response LIMIT 1) = 'APPROVED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), NULL)
WHERE article_id IN (SELECT article_id FROM valid_response);

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_doctors`
SET
  status = IF((SELECT decision FROM valid_response LIMIT 1) = 'APPROVED', 'DOCTOR_APPROVED', 'DOCTOR_CHANGES_REQUESTED'),
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM valid_response)
  AND doctor_id IN (SELECT doctor_id FROM valid_response);

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID(), 'article', article_id,
  IF(decision = 'APPROVED', 'doctor.approved', 'revision.requested'),
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'doctor_review_portal', NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(review_link_id, NULLIF(TRIM(@response), '') AS response))
FROM valid_response;

SELECT
  IF(v.article_id IS NOT NULL, TRUE, FALSE) AS valid,
  IF(v.article_id IS NOT NULL, v.decision, 'INVALID_OR_EXPIRED') AS status,
  v.article_id,
  IF(v.article_id IS NULL, 'This review link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.', NULL) AS error
FROM (SELECT 1 AS seed) s
LEFT JOIN valid_response v ON TRUE;

## AAC Phase 1F - Doctor Decision

Accepts `approve` or `request_changes`, prevents token replay, updates the article and approval state, and records an auditable workflow event. Change requests require non-empty feedback.

Connect the existing **Google BigQuery account** credential, then activate the workflow.
